name: popsicle
headline: Lead Digital: Marketing Automation Landing Page
short_description: Lead Digital is a landing page solution designed to automate marketing and sales outreach, helping businesses scale lead generation and reach more customers.
author: johncanero

sections.overview:
Lead Digital is a responsive landing page built for businesses looking to streamline marketing and sales automation. It provides a scalable solution for outreach campaigns designed to generate more leads for your company. The platform supports desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with light and dark mode options. Businesses can request beta access to test the platform and integrate it into their lead generation workflows. The landing page itself serves as a conversion tool for companies wanting to capture leads efficiently.
Creating a professional landing page for lead capture campaigns
Scaling outreach efforts for B2B sales teams
Setting up mobile-responsive marketing pages for multiple devices
Building brand presence with customizable landing page templates
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/johncanero/lead-digital`
sections.usage:
```
Create a lead landing page for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. The page should include a compelling headline, subheadline, and a clear call-to-action. Use [DATA] to highlight key benefits and include a form for capturing leads. Ensure the design is clean, professional, and optimized for conversions.
```
